en: For the conductor, with stringed instruments, a psalm, a song.

he: אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים יְחׇנֵּ֥נוּ וִיבָרְכֵ֑נוּ יָ֤אֵֽר־פָּנָ֖יו אִתָּ֣נוּ סֶֽלָה׃
en: Elokim be gracious to us and bless us; shine Your face with us, selah.
To know in the earth Your way; among all nations Your deliverance.

he: יוֹד֖וּךָ עַמִּ֥ים ׀ אֱלֹהִ֑ים י֝וֹד֗וּךָ עַמִּ֥ים כֻּלָּֽם׃
en: Peoples shall thank You, Elokim; peoples, all of them, shall thank You.

he: יִ֥שְׂמְח֥וּ וִירַנְּנ֗וּ לְאֻ֫מִּ֥ים כִּֽי־תִשְׁפֹּ֣ט עַמִּ֣ים מִישֹׁ֑ר וּלְאֻמִּ֓ים ׀ בָּאָ֖רֶץ תַּנְחֵ֣ם סֶֽלָה׃
en: Nations shall rejoice and sing, for You shall judge peoples with equity, and nations in the earth You shall lead, selah.

he: יוֹד֖וּךָ עַמִּ֥ים ׀ אֱלֹהִ֑ים י֝וֹד֗וּךָ עַמִּ֥ים כֻּלָּֽם׃
en: Peoples shall thank You, Elokim; peoples, all of them, shall thank You.

he: אֶ֭רֶץ נָתְנָ֣ה יְבוּלָ֑הּ יְ֝בָרְכֵ֗נוּ אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
en: The earth gave its produce; Elokim Elokeinu shall bless us.
Elokim shall bless us, and all the ends of the earth shall fear Him.
